title: Bobby Ray Inman acknowledges the National Underwater Reconnaissance Office

tellings.quote: he mentioned the national under underwater or undersea reconnaissance office neuro uh and so he he basically acknowledged it was a real thing. In all my years in the Navy as as the O head oceanographer and knowing having access to undersea classified programs, I've never even heard of that organization.

plain: Bobby Ray Inman, a former top US intelligence official, is said to have mentioned a National Underwater (or Undersea) Reconnaissance Office, and in doing so to have treated it as a real organisation. Tim Gallaudet, a retired Navy admiral who was the Navy's chief oceanographer, relays this from the researcher Sam Gerbus, and says that despite his access to classified undersea programmes he had never heard of such an office. If true, it would mean a secret agency watching the oceans exists even beyond the knowledge of the Navy's own top ocean expert.
